searched.title: A2L Spec Sheet
searched.note: 2 pages, every row read (pdftotext layout and raw). No layer height, hotend, high-flow, toolhead/nozzle camera, Bluetooth, application processor/NPU, rated/standby/steady-state power, current, noise, recommended space, certification, package size or gross weight rows. Rows without a registry key: Clumping Detection; the Cutting Module rows other than Cutting Area.

specs.value: Below 49 dB (Silent Mode); approx. 52 dB peak (Standard Mode)
specs.source_title: Bambu Lab US store product page
specs.locator: FAQ › 4. How is the noise level during normal printing?
specs.quote: In Silent Mode, noise levels stay below 49 dB (comparable to a quiet library whisper). In Standard Mode, peak noise is approximately 52 dB. (Data source: Bambu Lab internal testing)
specs.note: FAQ prose on the official page, not a spec-sheet row, so unverified (§C.6: a value from prose stays unverified). The spec sheet has no noise row.

specs.source_title: Bambu Lab US store product page
specs.locator: FAQ › 11. Is the blade-cutting functionality on the A2L identical to the H2 series?
specs.quote: The A2L does not have a BirdsEye camera, so it cannot perform the fully automatic Live Spatial Alignment found on the H2 series Laser versions.
specs.note: An explicit official statement of absence (FAQ answer), so the key is not 'not published'.
